# graph-manager: `graph-execution … --sandbox` in a terminal (shim + internal API) (KAN-88)

## What to build

In a graph-manager terminal, `graph-execution .agents/tasks/x --spec docs/prd/x.md --provider claude --web --sandbox` starts the run in a sandbox and prints `Run <id> started in a sandbox: <url>`; `graph-execution --resume --run <id> --sandbox` resumes a run in a new sandbox. Without `--sandbox` everything works as today. Terminals themselves are not sandboxed.

1. **The shim.** `<dataDir>/bin/graph-execution` (written by `writeGraphExecutionShim`, first on the terminals' PATH) becomes `GM_ENGINE_BIN=<engine cli.js> exec node "<graph-manager>/dist/server/shim.js" "$@"`. `shim.ts` (compiled to `dist/server/shim.js`):
   - without `--sandbox` in its arguments: spawns `node <GM_ENGINE_BIN> <args>` with `stdio: "inherit"`, ignores SIGINT/SIGTERM itself while the child runs (the terminal's Ctrl+C reaches the engine through the process group), and exits with the child's code (128 + signal number when killed by a signal);
   - with `--sandbox`: removes every `--sandbox`, removes `--web` (the server always serves the page), refuses `--web-serve`, and POSTs `{ cwd: process.cwd(), args }` to `${GM_INTERNAL_URL}/api/internal/sandbox-runs` with `Authorization: Bearer ${GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN}`. On 201 `{ runId, viewUrl, url }` it prints `Run <runId> started in a sandbox: <url>` and exits 0; on an error answer it prints `error: <error>` (and the `output` lines when present) to stderr and exits 2; without `GM_INTERNAL_URL`/`GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN` it prints `error: graph-execution --sandbox works only in a graph-manager terminal` and exits 2; a connection failure prints `error: graph-manager did not answer at <url>: <message>` and exits 2.
2. **The internal token.** `buildApp` creates `GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN` (32 random bytes, hex) per server start and knows the URL it listens on (`onListen`): `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (or `http://<config.host>:<port>` when `config.host` is a specific address other than `0.0.0.0` / `::`). Both are added to every terminal's env only (never to runs or sandboxes).
3. **`POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs`** `{ cwd: string, args: string[] }` — accepted only with that bearer token (else 401 `{ error: "bad internal token" }`), only from a loopback address (`req.ip` `127.0.0.1`, `::1`, `::ffff:127.0.0.1`, or `config.host`; else 403), and exempt from the session cookie check. It maps `cwd` to its workspace (the workspace whose path is `cwd` or contains it; none → 400 `the terminal is not inside a workspace`), then:
   - `args` with `--resume`: needs `--run <id>` (400 `--resume --sandbox needs --run <id>`); calls `resumeRun(ctx, ws, id, { sandbox: true })` (exported from `src/server/routes/resume.ts`).
   - otherwise a new run: refuses subcommands (`suite`, `clean`, `list`, `open`, `install`, `readme` as the first positional → 400 `--sandbox works only for runs`); needs `--provider <name>` (400 `missing required option --provider <name>`) and the tasks folder + `--spec` to resolve inside the workspace relative to `cwd` (400 as the start route: `tasksDir: <x> is not a folder inside the workspace` / `spec: <x> is not a file inside the workspace`); then `ctx.sandboxes.start({ ws, cwd, args, runId: newRunId(), providers: [provider] })` with `args` passed through (they are relative to `cwd`, which is mounted at the same path), minus any `--web` / `--sandbox` the caller left in and saves `workspaceSettings[ws.id].sandbox = true`.
   - answers 201 `{ runId, viewUrl, url }` where `url` = `${GM_PUBLIC_URL ?? <internal URL>}/runs/<ws>/<runId>` (the graph-manager run detail page).
   - `SandboxError` → its status with `{ error, output? }` (e.g. Docker not reachable → 400 with that reason, so the shim exits 2).

Already in the codebase: `Sandboxes.start(...)` / `SandboxError` (`src/server/sandbox.ts`, `src/server/sandbox-run.ts`), `resumeRun` (`src/server/routes/resume.ts`), `newRunId`, `insideWorkspace`, `viewUrlOf`, `lastLines`, `listWorkspaces`/`resolveWorkspace`, the engine's own refusal `--sandbox needs graph-manager` (exit 2) when the flag reaches it.

Spec: `docs/prd/sandboxes.md` (Requirements: "Terminals (`terminals.ts`): the shim becomes…", "`GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN` is random per server start…"; Decisions: "`graph-execution --sandbox` in a terminal is handled by graph-manager's shim…"; user story 2; acceptance "`graph-execution … --web --sandbox` in a graph-manager terminal prints `Run <id> started in a sandbox: …`" and "Without the Docker socket … `--sandbox` in a terminal exits 2"). KAN-89 / KAN-87 edit `terminals.ts` in parallel: keep the changes to `terminalEnv`/`TerminalManager` additive (a new option, a new parameter with a default).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (lines 40-46 `TerminalManagerOptions`, 79 `STRIPPED_ENV`, 103-119 `terminalEnv`, 121-129 `writeGraphExecutionShim`, 138-176 the constructor and `spawn`) — where the env and the shim come from.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 46-52) — `writeGraphExecutionShim(binDir, config.graphExecutionBin)` and `new TerminalManager({ workspacesDir, binDir })`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` (lines 52-64 `needsAuth`, 77-82 `needsSameOrigin`, 108-121 the hook) — `/api/internal/*` must skip the session check (it has its own); a POST without an `Origin` header already passes `originAllowed`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` — `newRunId`, `insideWorkspace`, `lastLines`, the sandbox start block (mirror its error mapping).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.ts` — `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId, { sandbox })`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` — `listWorkspaces(root)`, `insideWorkspaces(root, p)`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.test.ts` (lines 1-35 setup and `run()`, 118-127 the shim test) — terminal tests run real PTYs.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts` / `routes/runs.sandbox.test.ts` — app tests with the fake Docker (`startFakeDocker` from `../../../scripts/fake-docker.mjs`; without `exec`, a started container writes its ready file and stays running).
- `apps/graph-manager/tsconfig.json` — server files under `src/server/**/*.ts` compile to `dist/server/*.js` (so `shim.ts` → `dist/server/shim.js`); tests are excluded from the build.

## Patterns to follow

```ts
// terminals.ts:122-128
export function writeGraphExecutionShim(binDir: string, bin: string): boolean {
  if (!path.isAbsolute(bin) || !bin.endsWith(".js") || process.platform === "win32") return false;
  ...writeFileSync(file, `#!/bin/sh\nexec node ${JSON.stringify(bin)} "$@"\n`, { mode: 0o755 });
```

`shim.ts` must stay dependency-free (only `node:` imports, no import of other graph-manager modules) so it starts fast and works from `dist/server/` alone. Make its logic testable in-process: export `planShim(args: string[]): { mode: "engine"; args: string[] } | { mode: "sandbox"; args: string[] } | { mode: "error"; message: string }` and `async function runShim(argv: string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, io: { cwd: string; fetch: typeof fetch; spawnEngine: (args: string[]) => Promise<number>; out: (s: string) => void; err: (s: string) => void }): Promise<number>`, with the real `main()` at the bottom guarded by `if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` (the same `isMain` guard as `scripts/fake-forge.mjs:251`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** as described (planShim, runShim, main). `--sandbox` counts anywhere in the args; `--web-serve` with `--sandbox` → error `--web-serve is internal`. The engine is `env.GM_ENGINE_BIN` (missing → `error: GM_ENGINE_BIN is not set`, exit 2).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `writeGraphExecutionShim(binDir, bin, shimJs?: string)`: when `shimJs` is given and exists, write `#!/bin/sh\nGM_ENGINE_BIN=${JSON.stringify(bin)} exec node ${JSON.stringify(shimJs)} "$@"\n`; otherwise the current content (tests run from `src/`, where `shim.js` does not exist).
  - `TerminalManagerOptions` gets `/** Variables added to every terminal at spawn time (e.g. graph-manager's internal URL, known once listening). */ extraEnv?: () => Record<string, string>;` merged over `this.env` in `spawn()`.
- **GOTCHA**: `STRIPPED_ENV` keeps removing `GM_PASSWORD`; `GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN` comes only from `extraEnv`, so a terminal started from inside another graph-manager terminal does not leak the outer token into a different server.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `const internal = { token: randomBytes(32).toString("hex"), url: "" }`; `writeGraphExecutionShim(binDir, config.graphExecutionBin, fileURLToPath(new URL("./shim.js", import.meta.url)))`; `new TerminalManager({ …, extraEnv: () => ({ GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN: internal.token, ...(internal.url ? { GM_INTERNAL_URL: internal.url } : {}) }) })`; `app.addHook("onListen", async () => { const a = app.server.address(); if (a && typeof a === "object") internal.url = \`http://${loopbackHost(config.host)}:${a.port}\`; })`; `AppContext` gets `/** The terminals' token and URL for /api/internal/* (KAN-88). */ internal?: { token: string; url: string }`; register `await internalRoutes(app, ctx);` (one line).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `needsAuth`, `if (pathname.startsWith("/api/internal/")) return false;` before the `/api/` rule, with a comment that these routes check the internal bearer token themselves.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `internalRoutes(app, ctx)` with `POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs` as described. Token compare with `timingSafeEqual` over equal-length buffers. Parse the args with a small hand-written scanner (positional, `--spec <v>`, `--provider <v>`, `--run <v>`, `--resume`; other flags pass through untouched); do not import commander.

### Tests

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.test.ts` (in-process): `planShim(["x", "--web"])` → engine with the same args; `planShim(["x", "--spec", "s", "--provider", "fake", "--web", "--sandbox"])` → sandbox with `["x", "--spec", "s", "--provider", "fake"]`; `runShim` with a stub `fetch` answering 201 prints `Run gm-1 started in a sandbox: http://127.0.0.1:7420/runs/github~octo~hello/gm-1` and returns 0; a 400 `{ error: "Docker is not reachable at …" }` prints `error: Docker is not reachable at …` to `err` and returns 2; no token → 2 with the "only in a graph-manager terminal" message; engine mode calls `spawnEngine` with the args and returns its code; the request carries `authorization: Bearer <token>` and the JSON body `{ cwd, args }`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (fake Docker without exec, `appWithLogin({ dockerSocket, sandboxImage: "img:1" })`, workspace with committed `diamond` + `spec.md`; build the app with `buildApp(config, { …, internalToken: "t0ken" })` — add that option to `BuildAppOptions` (`/** Fixed internal token (tests); random otherwise. */ internalToken?: string`) — and log in as `appWithLogin` does, or call `buildApp` directly as `routes/runs.test.ts` does): no token → 401; wrong token → 401; no cookie but the right token → not 401; a `cwd` outside every workspace → 400; new run → 201 with `runId`, `url` ending `/runs/github~octo~hello/<runId>`, a fake container `gm-run-<runId>` whose `Cmd` is `node /opt/gm-tools/graph-execution/dist/cli.js diamond --spec spec.md --provider fake --web-serve` and `WorkingDir` the cwd; `["suite", …]` → 400; missing `--provider` → 400; `--resume` without `--run` → 400; unreachable Docker (`dockerSocket: "/nonexistent.sock"`) → 400 with the reason.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.test.ts` (extend): `writeGraphExecutionShim(dir, cli, shimJs)` with a stub `shimJs` file writes the `GM_ENGINE_BIN=… exec node <shimJs>` form; `extraEnv` values reach the terminal (`echo $GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.dist.test.ts`: `it.skipIf(!existsSync(<apps/graph-manager/dist/server/shim.js>))` — `GM_ENGINE_BIN=<built engine> node dist/server/shim.js --version` prints the engine version; `… x --sandbox` without the token exits 2.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In a graph-manager terminal, `graph-execution … --web --sandbox` prints `Run <id> started in a sandbox: <url>` and the run appears on the Runs page; `--resume --run <id> --sandbox` resumes in a new sandbox.
- [ ] Without `--sandbox`, the shim runs the engine exactly as before (args, exit code, Ctrl+C).
- [ ] `--sandbox` without Docker exits 2 with the server's reason.
- [ ] `/api/internal/*` needs the per-boot bearer token and a loopback client; the token is only in terminal env.
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager -- shim internal terminals`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- shim internal terminals auth
npm test
```

Then try it live as `TESTING.md` "graph-manager" describes (fake forge, clone `octo/hello`, commit the engine's `diamond` fixture and `spec.md` in it), with the fake Docker: `node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --exec &` and the server started with `GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock GM_SANDBOX_IMAGE=node:22-bookworm`. In a terminal: `graph-execution diamond --spec spec.md --provider fake --web --sandbox`.
